title: Care of the Deaf and Hard of Hearing

# Care of the Deaf and Hard of Hearing

![Visual reference from Care of the Deaf and Hard of Hearing](../../assets/figures/page-0187-visual.webp)

# MAINE EMS
## EMS Communication Card
### For Medical, Physical, and Emotional Information

> **INSTRUCTIONS:** Have the patient touch pictures to request wants and needs. If unable, the caregiver touches pictures and gets yes/no response from patient. This may be helpful for patients who are deaf, hard of hearing, or could have traumatic brain injury, autism, or an intellectual disability.
>
> **Yes** = thumbs up, nod, or eyes wide open
> **No** = thumbs down, nod, or eyes closed

---

### Touch for YES / NO
* **Touch for YES**: YES=eyes wide open
* **Touch for NO**: NO=eyes closed

### Call This Number
* (1) (2) (3)
* (4) (5) (6)
* (7) (8) (9)
* (\*) (0) (#)

---

### Quick communication tips
* Get my attention first.
* Make eye contact when you speak.
* Speak clearly at a normal pace and tone.
* Do not cover your mouth.
* I may have memory issues and it may take me longer to process what you are telling me.
* I cannot lipread everything you say.
* A cochlear implant or hearing aid does not mean I can hear and understand everything you say.
* I may only understand sign language.

### The best way to communicate with me is:
* Interpreter
* Texting
* Writing
* Lipread
* I Cannot Lipread
* Assistive Listening Device

---

This resource is a collaboration between the Maine Department of Public Safety and the Maine Department of Labor Division of the Deaf and Hard of Hearing and Late Deafened

---

### Touch Where It Hurts
* Front
* Back

### Pain Scale
* **0** No Pain
* **2** Hurts Little
* **4** Hurts Little More
* **6** Hurts Even More
* **8** Hurts Whole Lot
* **10** Worst Pain

---

O P Q R S T U V W X Y Z

---

### Touch for YES / NO
* **Touch for YES**: YES=eyes wide open
* **Touch for NO**: NO=eyes closed

### Common Medical Issues
* Breathing Problems/COPD
* Stroke
* High Blood Pressure
* Cardiac/Heart Issues
* Diabetes
* Seizure/Epilepsy
* Sensitive to touch
